title: A Demonstration of Correlation Analysis in Python and Quarto
text:
Introduction

import pandas as pd 
import numpy as np 

import seaborn as sns

sns.set_context('talk')

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = sns.load_dataset('iris')

The iris dataset form seaborn offers a great opportunity to learn more about correlation analysis in Python and Quarto where we will be working with data from 150 flowers and our research question is to study whether the petal width correlated with petal width.


Literature Review


Method
Given that we have two columns of continuous data (length of petal and width of petal measured in mm), we will evaluate this relationship using simple correlation analysis and also a scatterplot. These two methods are classic and traditional starting points when evaluating data like these.


Results

corr_val = np.array(df[['petal_length', 'petal_width']].corr())[0][1]

narrative = "a very strong negative correlation"

if corr_val > 0.8:
    narrative = "a very strong positive correlation"
elif corr_val > 0.4:
    narrative = "a moderate positive correlation"
elif corr_val > 0:
    narrative = "a weak positive correlation" 
elif corr_val > -0.4:
    narrative = "a moderate negative correlation"

Using the classic simple Pearson correlation approach these data produce a correlation coefficient of 0.96287, so we conclude the relationship is a very strong positive correlation.

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize = (6, 3.5))

sns.scatterplot(data = df, y = 'petal_length', x = 'petal_width')

plt.ylabel('Petal Length (mm)')
plt.xlabel('Petal Width (mm)')







Figure 1: A scatterplot of petal length and width





As shown in Figure 1 we see additional evidence of a strong positive correlation between an iris flower petal length and petal width.


Discussion
Now we know how to do correlation coefficient analysis from this example work-through of the iris dataset using Python and Quarto and we have found a positive correlative relationship between iris petal width and iris petal length.


Additional Code Went Over in Lecture

sns.lmplot(data = df, y = 'petal_length', x = 'petal_width')

sns.jointplot(x = df['petal_width'], y = df['petal_length'], kind = "hex")
